summary_1line: Rama and Sita enjoy peaceful royal life in a magnificent grove; Sita, now pregnant, asks to visit the hermitages of sages on the Ganges.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama leads Sita by the hand into the lush Ashoka grove filled with flowering trees, lotus pools, and humming bees.
Seated on a flower-decked throne in the grove, Rama offers Sita honey-wine while celestial nymphs dance and sing around them.
A radiant Sita adorned with jewels stands before Rama and shyly reveals her wish to visit the hermitages by the Ganges.
